verified_scope: Six-month observational pimavanserin study of 26 people, including 21 with Parkinson disease. The outcomes include the Neuropsychiatric Inventory and quality of life.

Three-day diet records from 24 Parkinson outpatients, including 15 with sarcopenia and nine without, supply an overall protein comparison. The report names no dried figs and has no visual episode outcome.

Liquid meal hemodynamics and octreotide in autonomic failure. Eight participants with Parkinson disease belong to the 67-person sample. The protocol records blood pressure and specifies no dried figs.
PET and perceptual outcomes among 11 Parkinson participants with visual symptoms and nine without. The reported association with UM-PDHQ is uncorrected. This is a separate group from EPR-016.
Resting microstate transition in 19 Parkinson patients with hallucinations compared with 20 matched patients. The group contrast does not test food or count visual episodes.
Task-evoked visual categorization and semantic processing in 23 Parkinson participants with minor hallucinations and 23 without. No fig intervention.
The 2020 abstract and 2021 paper share the 95-person cardiac MIBG cohort, 22 of 37 abnormal probable Lewy scans and 38 of 43 normal Alzheimer-type scans.
